story.head: The Bruins run away from the Penguins
paras: The first period was a wild one. Justin Brazeau opened the scoring for the Penguins midway through the period. Pavel Zacha, Mark Kastelic and Elias Lindholm scored three goals in just under seven minutes later in the period to turn a 1-0 deficit into a 3-1 lead. Nick Robertson cut Boston’s lead to 3-2 early in the second, but that was as close as they got. Zacha and Morgan Geekie scored two and a half minutes apart midway through the period to stretch the lead to 5-2, and the Pens never had an answer. Fraser Minten made it 6-2 midway through the third.

The Bruins had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Penguins 24-18. The Penguins hit two posts and the crossbar and still lost. Michael DiPietro made 16 saves for the Bruins, and Artūrs Šilovs allowed six goals on 24 shots. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Hampus Lindholm, by our Swing measure.

Only two penalties were called all night, something the league sees about once every 20 games. The Bruins improved to 12-4-1, still first in the Atlantic, while the Penguins dropped to 5-9-2, seventh in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Three straight wins for the Bruins.
The Penguins are winless in four (0-3-1).
Pavel Zacha scored twice more against Pittsburgh, and has eight goals in ten games against them since 2023-24.
Morgan Geekie has scored in three straight games.
